name: contacts-science-gallery
description: Temporal face-to-face proximity contacts. Nodes represent individuals. Original data are pairwise contacts; hyperedges are constructed by promoting cliques of contacts into higher-order group interactions.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., contacts-science-gallery).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

edges_metadata.date: (STRING) Calendar date of the contact event (e.g., 2009-07-01).
edges_metadata.original_time: (INT) Original timestamp of the contact event (e.g., 1246442239).
edges_metadata.time: (INT) Normalized timestamp of the contact event (e.g., 5529220).
